version_scope: Official build_sam3_image_model uses SAM3 checkpoint; SAM3.1 release and new entry points use multiplex video. This is a SAM3 image baseline, not a SAM3.1 image claim.

runtime.dtype: float32 weights and CPU float32 inference, native unfused MLP (after bfloat16 CPU watchdog)

scratch_portability_changes: position_encoding.py: positional cache allocation chooses CPU if CUDA unavailable, retaining all precompute sizes and mathematics
decoder.py: relative-position coordinate cache allocation chooses CPU if CUDA unavailable
sam3_tracker_utils.py: move Triton EDT import into its sole caller sample_one_point_from_error_center, which is not used by frozen supplied point inference
vitdet.Mlp.forward: non-CUDA uses same self.act(self.fc1(x)) instead of fused addmm_act; same linear/GELU computation, native float32 instead of forced bfloat16
geometry_encoders.py: pin scale tensor memory only for CUDA; retain same scale tensor, dtype and device transfer
checkpoint_loading: torch.load(weights_only=True, map_location=cpu); official detector/tracker key remapping followed by strict=True state loading

pre_embedding_diagnostic.error: RuntimeError: mat1 and mat2 must have the same dtype, but got BFloat16 and Float
pre_embedding_diagnostic.location: vitdet.Mlp.forward -> self.fc2 after perflib.fused.addmm_act forces bfloat16
pre_embedding_diagnostic.outcome: No completed embedding or mask prediction; CPU bfloat16 autocast added to match official fused MLP precision contract
pre_embedding_diagnostic.followup_outcome: CPU bfloat16 reached 180s portrait watchdog before first embedding; no quality result
pre_embedding_diagnostic.export_note: Text scores/boxes/probabilities converted via float() before NumPy because NumPy does not support bfloat16; official interactive API already does this

float32_diagnostic.error: geometry_encoders.py651 scale.pin_memory(): CPU storage versus MPS storage mismatch
float32_diagnostic.outcome: Embedding completed, first text forward failed before producing masks; no completed prediction to select or tune
float32_diagnostic.fused_equivalence_check: GELU(x @ W.T + b), float32 small random input: aten._addmm_activation versus native linear+GELU max absolute difference 0.0

successful_run.quality_status: Not visually assessed by baseline agent; native output preserved for independent review

text_contract.confidence: sigmoid(class logit) times sigmoid(presence logit), retained when > 0.5
text_contract.mask: bilinear interpolation to original dimensions with align_corners=False, sigmoid then >0.5
text_contract.retention: Every returned instance, score, pixel xyxy box and probability raster; binary union separate

points_contract.coordinates: frozen 5 positive + 7 negative original pixel xy points; normalize_coords default True
points_contract.retention: All three candidate masks and predicted IoUs plus low-resolution logits; highest predicted IoU saved separately, no visual substitution

exclusions: No production changes, no prompt tuning, no automatic retries, no source-photo uploads, no alpha-matting or edit applied
